description: The paper models tuberculosis dynamics considering vaccination and reinfection using a deterministic compartmental model. It includes compartments for susceptible, vaccinated, infected, and recovered individuals. The model analyzes the influence of treatment failure and vaccination on tuberculosis control strategies, incorporating parameters like infection rate, vaccination rate, and recovery rate. The model also examines the impact of reinfection and temporary immunity on disease persistence.
